examples.en: Farmers use nets to keep every pest away from the fruit.
examples.zh: 農夫用網子讓害蟲遠離水果。

examples.en: My little brother can be a real pest when I study.
examples.zh: 我讀書的時候，弟弟真的很煩人。

examples.en: The company sells a spray that controls garden pests.
examples.zh: 這家公司販售能防治園藝害蟲的噴劑。

examples.en: A rainbow is a natural phenomenon caused by sunlight and rain.
examples.zh: 彩虹是由陽光與雨水造成的自然現象。

examples.en: Bubble tea became a worldwide phenomenon in just a few years.
examples.zh: 珍珠奶茶短短幾年內就成了全球現象。

examples.en: Scientists are studying this strange phenomenon in the ocean.
examples.zh: 科學家正在研究海洋裡這種奇特的現象。

examples.en: The philosopher asked his students to think about happiness.
examples.zh: 那位哲學家請學生思考什麼是快樂。

examples.en: My uncle is a philosopher who teaches at a university.
examples.zh: 我叔叔是一位在大學任教的哲學家。

examples.en: Many philosophers have tried to answer this question.
examples.zh: 許多哲學家都試圖回答這個問題。

examples.en: We had a philosophical discussion about the meaning of life.
examples.zh: 我們針對人生的意義進行了一場哲學討論。

examples.en: She is philosophical about losing the game and just smiles.
examples.zh: 她對輸掉比賽看得很開，只是笑了笑。

examples.en: The book raises several philosophical questions about right and wrong.
examples.zh: 這本書提出了幾個關於對錯的哲學問題。

examples.en: He studies philosophy at National Taiwan University.
examples.zh: 他在台灣大學讀哲學。

examples.en: Our teacher's philosophy is that everyone can learn.
examples.zh: 我們老師的信念是人人都能學會。

examples.en: This restaurant has a simple philosophy about fresh food.
examples.zh: 這家餐廳對新鮮食材有著簡單的理念。

examples.en: She joined the photography club at school.
examples.zh: 她加入了學校的攝影社。

examples.en: Digital photography has made taking pictures much easier.
examples.zh: 數位攝影讓拍照容易多了。

examples.en: His photography of mountains won a prize last year.
examples.zh: 他拍攝的山景攝影作品去年得了獎。

examples.en: Regular physical exercise helps students stay healthy and concentrate in class.
examples.zh: 規律的體能運動有助於學生保持健康，並在課堂上專心。

examples.en: The doctor gave him a full physical checkup.
examples.zh: 醫生為他做了完整的身體檢查。

examples.en: The physical properties of water change when it freezes.
examples.zh: 水結冰時，物理性質會改變。

examples.en: I have a physical next Monday before the trip.
examples.zh: 我下週一出發旅行前要做健康檢查。

examples.en: The school requires every new student to have a physical.
examples.zh: 學校要求每位新生都要做體檢。

examples.en: She passed her physical without any problems.
examples.zh: 她順利通過了體檢，沒有任何問題。

examples.en: The physician told her to rest and drink more water.
examples.zh: 醫師叫她多休息、多喝水。

examples.en: My grandfather worked as a physician for forty years.
examples.zh: 我爺爺當了四十年的醫師。

examples.en: You should see a physician if the fever continues.
examples.zh: 如果持續發燒，你應該去看醫生。

examples.en: The physicist explained how light travels through space.
examples.zh: 那位物理學家解釋了光如何在太空中傳播。

examples.en: Einstein was a famous physicist who changed modern science.
examples.zh: 愛因斯坦是改變現代科學的著名物理學家。

examples.en: My cousin wants to become a physicist one day.
examples.zh: 我表哥希望有一天能成為物理學家。

examples.en: He was a pioneer in the field of computer design.
examples.zh: 他是電腦設計領域的先驅。

examples.en: Early pioneers crossed the country in wooden wagons.
examples.zh: 早期的開拓者坐著木製馬車橫越全國。

examples.en: Our school is a pioneer in using tablets for learning.
examples.zh: 我們學校是使用平板電腦學習的先驅。

examples.en: The company pioneered a new way to recycle plastic bottles.
examples.zh: 那家公司開創了回收塑膠瓶的新方法。

examples.en: Doctors in this hospital pioneered the new treatment.
examples.zh: 這家醫院的醫師率先開發出這種新療法。

examples.en: She pioneered online classes for students in small villages.
examples.zh: 她率先為偏鄉學生開辦線上課程。

examples.en: Fresh fruit is plentiful in Taiwan during the summer.
examples.zh: 夏天的台灣有大量的新鮮水果。

examples.en: Food was plentiful at the family dinner.
examples.zh: 家庭聚餐時食物很充足。

examples.en: Rain is plentiful in this part of the island.
examples.zh: 島上這一帶的雨量很充沛。

examples.en: The plot of this movie is easy to follow.
examples.zh: 這部電影的情節很容易看懂。

examples.en: They bought a small plot of land near the lake.
examples.zh: 他們在湖邊買了一小塊地。

examples.en: The detective uncovered a plot to steal the museum's painting.
examples.zh: 偵探揭發了一項偷走博物館畫作的陰謀。

examples.en: The students plot the data on a graph in math class.
examples.zh: 學生們在數學課把數據畫在圖表上。

examples.en: We plotted our route on the map before the hike.
examples.zh: 健行前，我們在地圖上標出了路線。

examples.en: The friends plotted a surprise party for her.
examples.zh: 朋友們策劃了一場給她的驚喜派對。

examples.en: My grandmother makes jam from fresh plums every summer.
examples.zh: 我奶奶每年夏天都用新鮮李子做果醬。

examples.en: I packed a ripe plum in my lunch box.
examples.zh: 我在便當盒裡放了一顆熟透的李子。

examples.en: The plum tree in our yard is full of white flowers.
examples.zh: 我們院子裡的李樹開滿了白花。

examples.en: The plumber came to fix the leaking sink.
examples.zh: 水管工人來修漏水的水槽。

examples.en: We called a plumber because the bathroom pipe was blocked.
examples.zh: 浴室水管堵住了，所以我們請了水管工人。

examples.en: My uncle works as a plumber in Taichung.
examples.zh: 我叔叔在台中當水管工人。

examples.en: Some wild mushrooms are poisonous, so do not eat them.
examples.zh: 有些野生蕈菇有毒，所以不要吃。

examples.en: The poisonous snake hid under the rocks.
examples.zh: 那條毒蛇躲在石頭下面。

examples.en: Keep these poisonous cleaning products away from children.
examples.zh: 請讓這些有毒的清潔用品遠離小孩。

examples.en: He polishes his shoes every Sunday night.
examples.zh: 他每週日晚上都會把鞋子擦亮。

examples.en: Please polish your essay before you hand it in.
examples.zh: 交作業前，請把你的文章再潤飾一下。

examples.en: The waiter polished the glasses until they shone.
examples.zh: 服務生把玻璃杯擦到閃閃發亮。

examples.en: I need some shoe polish for my school shoes.
examples.zh: 我需要一些鞋油來保養學校的皮鞋。

examples.en: She applied red nail polish before going to the party.
examples.zh: 她去派對前擦了紅色指甲油。

examples.en: The table could use a good polish.
examples.zh: 這張桌子需要好好擦亮一下。

examples.en: I bought a portable charger for my phone.
examples.zh: 我買了一個手機用的攜帶式充電器。

examples.en: This portable speaker is small enough to fit in a bag.
examples.zh: 這個攜帶式喇叭小到可以放進包包裡。

examples.en: A portable fan is useful on a hot day.
examples.zh: 在大熱天，攜帶式電風扇很有用。

examples.en: The painting portrays a farmer working in the field.
examples.zh: 這幅畫描繪一位農夫在田裡工作。

examples.en: The movie portrays life in Taipei in the 1980s.
examples.zh: 這部電影描繪了一九八〇年代的台北生活。

examples.en: She portrays a kind teacher in the new drama.
examples.zh: 她在新的連續劇裡飾演一位親切的老師。

examples.en: Our family does not possess a car.
examples.zh: 我們家沒有車子。

examples.en: She possesses a rare talent for music.
examples.zh: 她擁有難得的音樂天分。

examples.en: The museum possesses several old maps of the island.
examples.zh: 博物館藏有幾張這座島的古地圖。

examples.en: Please keep your personal possessions with you on the train.
examples.zh: 搭火車時請隨身攜帶您的個人物品。

examples.en: His most important possession is an old guitar.
examples.zh: 他最重要的物品是一把舊吉他。

examples.en: The police found him in possession of a stolen bike.
examples.zh: 警方發現他持有一輛失竊的腳踏車。

examples.en: The postage for this letter to Japan is thirty dollars.
examples.zh: 這封寄到日本的信郵資是三十元。

examples.en: Don't forget to pay the postage before you mail the package.
examples.zh: 寄包裹前別忘了付郵資。

examples.en: Online shops often charge extra postage for large items.
examples.zh: 網路商店常會對大型商品額外收取郵資。

examples.en: The company is looking for potential customers abroad.
examples.zh: 這家公司正在海外尋找潛在客戶。

examples.en: Heavy rain is a potential danger for hikers.
examples.zh: 大雨對登山客是潛在的危險。

examples.en: He is a potential candidate for class president.
examples.zh: 他是班長的可能人選。

examples.en: The coach saw great potential in the young player.
examples.zh: 教練看出這位年輕球員很有潛力。

examples.en: Every child has the potential to learn new things.
examples.zh: 每個孩子都有學習新事物的潛能。

examples.en: This small town has the potential to attract more tourists.
examples.zh: 這個小鎮有吸引更多觀光客的潛力。

examples.en: Please give me the precise time of the meeting.
examples.zh: 請告訴我會議的確切時間。

examples.en: The teacher gave us precise instructions for the test.
examples.zh: 老師給了我們考試的明確說明。

examples.en: A scale must be precise to weigh medicine.
examples.zh: 秤藥物的磅秤必須很精準。

examples.en: No one can predict the weather a month ahead.
examples.zh: 沒有人能預測一個月後的天氣。

examples.en: Experts predict that prices will rise next year.
examples.zh: 專家預測明年物價會上漲。

examples.en: Can you predict who will win the baseball game?
examples.zh: 你能預測誰會贏得這場棒球賽嗎？

examples.en: His prediction about the test turned out to be correct.
examples.zh: 他對這次考試的預測結果是對的。

examples.en: The weather prediction says it will rain tomorrow.
examples.zh: 天氣預測說明天會下雨。

examples.en: Scientists made a prediction about the number of visitors.
examples.zh: 科學家對遊客人數做了預測。

examples.en: She felt tired during the early weeks of her pregnancy.
examples.zh: 她懷孕初期那幾週覺得很疲倦。

examples.en: The doctor gave her advice about a healthy pregnancy.
examples.zh: 醫生給了她健康懷孕的建議。

examples.en: Her pregnancy lasted nine months, and the baby was born healthy.
examples.zh: 她的孕期歷時九個月，寶寶出生時很健康。

examples.en: My aunt is pregnant and will have a baby in May.
examples.zh: 我阿姨懷孕了，五月就要生寶寶。

examples.en: Pregnant women can use the priority seats on the MRT.
examples.zh: 孕婦可以使用捷運的優先座位。

examples.en: She was five months pregnant when we visited her.
examples.zh: 我們去探望她時，她已經懷孕五個月了。

examples.en: I have to give a presentation in English class tomorrow.
examples.zh: 我明天要在英文課做簡報。

examples.en: The presentation of the food was beautiful.
examples.zh: 這道料理擺盤得很漂亮。

examples.en: The presentation of the awards will start at noon.
examples.zh: 頒獎典禮中午開始。

examples.en: We should preserve old buildings for future generations.
examples.zh: 我們應該為後代子孫保存老建築。

examples.en: She preserves fruit by making jam and storing it in jars.
examples.zh: 她把水果做成果醬，裝罐保存。

examples.en: The museum works hard to preserve ancient paintings.
examples.zh: 博物館努力保護古老的畫作。

examples.en: My mother made plum preserves from our own tree.
examples.zh: 我媽媽用自家樹上的李子做了果醬。

examples.en: The island is a nature preserve for rare birds.
examples.zh: 這座島是稀有鳥類的自然保護區。

examples.en: The shop sells strawberry preserves in small jars.
examples.zh: 這家店販售小罐裝的草莓果醬。

examples.en: Prevention is better than cure.
examples.zh: 預防勝於治療。

examples.en: Washing your hands is important for disease prevention.
examples.zh: 洗手對預防疾病很重要。

examples.en: The city started a new fire prevention campaign.
examples.zh: 市政府展開了新的防火宣導活動。

examples.en: Safety is our prime concern on school trips.
examples.zh: 安全是我們校外教學最重要的考量。

examples.en: This restaurant is in a prime location near the station.
examples.zh: 這家餐廳位於車站附近的黃金地段。

examples.en: Seven is a prime number because its only positive factors are one and seven.
examples.zh: 七是質數，因為它的正因數只有一和七。

examples.en: The singer is in her prime and sells out every concert.
examples.zh: 那位歌手正值巔峰，每場演唱會都一票難求。

examples.en: He was in his prime when he won the championship.
examples.zh: 他在全盛時期贏得了冠軍。

examples.en: Our grandfather often talks about his prime as a farmer.
examples.zh: 我爺爺常提起他務農全盛時期的事。

examples.en: Primitive people made tools from stone to hunt and prepare food.
examples.zh: 原始人用石頭製作工具，以狩獵和準備食物。

examples.en: The cabin had only primitive kitchen equipment.
examples.zh: 那間小木屋只有簡陋的廚房設備。

examples.en: Scientists study primitive forms of life in the ocean.
examples.zh: 科學家研究海洋中的原始生物形態。

examples.en: Everyone has the right to privacy, including on social media.
examples.zh: 每個人都有隱私權，在社群媒體上也不例外。

examples.en: Please respect my privacy and knock before you come in.
examples.zh: 請尊重我的隱私，進來前先敲門。

examples.en: The app protects your privacy with a strong password.
examples.zh: 這個應用程式用高強度密碼保護你的隱私。

examples.en: Members of the club have the privilege of using the pool.
examples.zh: 俱樂部會員享有使用游泳池的特權。

examples.en: It is a privilege to meet such a famous writer.
examples.zh: 能見到這麼有名的作家是我的榮幸。

examples.en: Older students enjoy certain privileges at our school.
examples.zh: 高年級學生在我們學校享有某些特權。

examples.en: Please follow the safety procedure in the lab.
examples.zh: 請遵守實驗室的安全程序。

examples.en: The procedure for applying for a library card is simple.
examples.zh: 申請借書證的手續很簡單。

examples.en: The doctor explained the procedure to the patient.
examples.zh: 醫生向病人說明了處置的步驟。

examples.en: After the break, the class will proceed with the lesson.
examples.zh: 休息過後，班上將繼續上課。

examples.en: Please proceed to gate twelve for boarding.
examples.zh: 請前往十二號登機門登機。

examples.en: He took a deep breath and proceeded to answer the question.
examples.zh: 他深吸一口氣，接著開始回答問題。

senses.zh: 多產的；有成效的；生產力高的

examples.en: We had a productive meeting and finished all the work.
examples.zh: 我們開了一場很有成效的會議，把工作都完成了。

examples.en: This is a productive farm that grows many vegetables.
examples.zh: 這是一座產量豐富的農場，種植了許多蔬菜。

examples.en: I feel more productive after a good night's sleep.
examples.zh: 睡了一夜好覺後，我覺得更有效率。

examples.en: Teaching is a respected profession in Taiwan.
examples.zh: 教書在台灣是受人尊敬的職業。

examples.en: The application form asks you to state your profession clearly.
examples.zh: 申請表要求你清楚填寫自己的職業。

examples.en: By profession, she is an engineer who designs bridges and tunnels.
examples.zh: 她的職業是工程師，負責設計橋梁與隧道。

examples.en: She gave us professional advice about our website.
examples.zh: 她針對我們的網站給了專業的建議。

examples.en: He wants to become a professional baseball player.
examples.zh: 他想成為職業棒球選手。

examples.en: The staff at this hotel are very professional.
examples.zh: 這間飯店的員工非常專業。

examples.en: The kitchen is run by a team of professionals.
examples.zh: 廚房由一群專業人士負責營運。

examples.en: My sister is a young professional working in a bank.
examples.zh: 我姊姊是在銀行工作的年輕專業人士。

examples.en: Only professionals should fix the electric wires.
examples.zh: 只有專業人員才應該修理電線。

examples.en: The shop became profitable after only six months.
examples.zh: 這家店只花了六個月就開始獲利。

examples.en: Selling fruit online turned out to be very profitable.
examples.zh: 在網路上賣水果結果非常賺錢。

examples.en: It was a profitable year for the company.
examples.zh: 對這家公司來說，那是獲利豐厚的一年。

examples.en: She is a prominent lawyer in Kaohsiung.
examples.zh: 她是高雄一位知名的律師。

examples.en: The clock hangs in a prominent place on the wall.
examples.zh: 時鐘掛在牆上很顯眼的位置。

examples.en: Green was the most prominent color in the painting.
examples.zh: 綠色是這幅畫中最顯眼的顏色。

examples.en: He is a promising young singer with a beautiful voice.
examples.zh: 他是一位有前途的年輕歌手，嗓音很美。

examples.en: The test results look promising, but further research is needed.
examples.zh: 測試結果看來很有希望，但仍需進一步研究。

examples.en: The team has a promising start to the season.
examples.zh: 這支球隊的球季開局很有希望。

examples.en: She received a promotion after working there for five years.
examples.zh: 她在那裡工作五年後獲得升遷。

examples.en: The store has a special promotion on school bags this week.
examples.zh: 這家店本週有書包的特價促銷活動。

examples.en: The team's promotion to the top division delighted its fans.
examples.zh: 球隊升上頂級聯賽，讓球迷非常高興。

examples.en: Thank you for your prompt reply to my email.
examples.zh: 謝謝你迅速回覆我的電子郵件。

examples.en: The bus driver is always prompt and never late.
examples.zh: 這位公車司機總是很準時，從不遲到。

examples.en: We need prompt action to fix the problem.
examples.zh: 我們需要迅速採取行動來解決問題。

examples.en: The teacher prompted him with the first word of the answer.
examples.zh: 老師用答案的第一個字提示他。

examples.en: The smell of bread prompted me to go into the shop.
examples.zh: 麵包的香味讓我走進了那家店。

examples.en: A sudden noise prompted everyone to look up.
examples.zh: 一陣突如其來的聲響讓大家都抬起頭來。

examples.en: A prompt on the screen asks you to enter your name.
examples.zh: 螢幕上的提示要求你輸入姓名。

examples.en: The writing prompt for today's class is about summer.
examples.zh: 今天課堂的寫作題目是關於夏天。

examples.en: Click the prompt to continue to the next page.
examples.zh: 點選提示以繼續前往下一頁。

examples.en: Her English pronunciation is clear and easy to understand.
examples.zh: 她的英文發音清楚又好懂。

examples.en: Can you check the pronunciation of this word in the dictionary?
examples.zh: 你可以查一下字典裡這個字的發音嗎？

examples.en: The teacher helped us practice the pronunciation of difficult words.
examples.zh: 老師幫我們練習困難單字的發音。

examples.en: The manager accepted our proposal for a new project.
examples.zh: 經理接受了我們新專案的提案。

examples.en: The city council discussed a proposal to build a new park.
examples.zh: 市議會討論了興建新公園的提案。

examples.en: She said yes to his marriage proposal.
examples.zh: 她答應了他的求婚。

examples.en: The small town began to prosper after the factory opened.
examples.zh: 工廠開張後，這個小鎮開始繁榮起來。

examples.en: Her business prospered because of good service.
examples.zh: 她的生意因為服務良好而興旺。

examples.en: Plants prosper in warm and sunny weather.
examples.zh: 植物在溫暖晴朗的天氣裡長得很茂盛。

examples.en: The new railway brought prosperity to the village.
examples.zh: 新鐵路為這個村莊帶來了繁榮。

examples.en: We wish you health and prosperity in the new year.
examples.zh: 祝你新年健康興旺。

examples.en: The country enjoyed years of peace and prosperity.
examples.zh: 這個國家享有多年的和平與繁榮。

examples.en: Taipei is a modern and prosperous city.
examples.zh: 台北是一座現代又繁榮的城市。

examples.en: His uncle runs a prosperous restaurant near the station.
examples.zh: 他叔叔在車站附近經營一家生意興隆的餐廳。

examples.en: We hope for a happy and prosperous future.
examples.zh: 我們期盼一個快樂又富足的未來。

examples.en: Eggs and fish are good sources of protein.
examples.zh: 蛋和魚是蛋白質的良好來源。

examples.en: Athletes need enough protein to build strong muscles.
examples.zh: 運動員需要足夠的蛋白質來增強肌肉。

examples.en: Beans are a cheap source of protein for many families.
examples.zh: 豆類是許多家庭取得蛋白質的便宜來源。
